positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Partnership Experience and Subscriptions
positions.description:
- Led work with strategic partnerships, delivering multiple types of incentives, loyalty integrations, and promotional experiences through close collaboration with 6+ cross-functional teams.
- Designed and launched partnership campaign tooling and redemption flows, enabling scalable, multi-offer campaign setup with significantly reduced engineering involvement.
- Modernized Instacart membership subscription renewal system and consolidated subscription placements to improve reliability and maintainability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Growth Platform
positions.description:
- Led a 5-engineer team to deliver scalable marketing placement systems for Enterprise tooling
- Built reusable promotional components and expanded incentives to paid marketing channels (+18% CVR)
- Led marketing incentive redemption redesign, boosting coupon usage by 40%

positions.title: Software Engineer - Growth Acquisition
positions.description:
- Delivered growth and engagement initiatives, including homepage redesign, SEO-driven city pages, guest mode redirects, and landing page optimizations, generating ~$74M incremental GMV and boosting activation rates by 20%+.
- Improved landing page performance, increasing order rates by 1–2%, and built retailer index pages to support marketing efforts.
- Enhanced incentive management systems and laid the groundwork for scalable promotional tooling.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Streamlined large-scale data ingestion pipelines using Apache NiFi and Kafka Streams, significantly improving processing efficiency.
- Developed a Crypto Service to handle encrypted user data for marketing systems securely.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed ReactJS components and QA tools to improve website personalization and recommendation systems.
- Enhanced Kafka infrastructure with SSL, authentication, and authorization features to strengthen data security.
- Contributed to scalable data processing solutions supporting Walmart’s e-commerce platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed monitoring dashboards, Java APIs, and responsive web applications that improved visibility, management, and automation of data integration pipelines, enabling developers to build, test, and operate large-scale data workflows efficiently.
